<document id=DOC_resume_at_floor>
Languages: Python, SQL.
Platform: Linux administration, Git.
Services: REST API design, unit testing, CI pipelines.
Infrastructure: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible.
Observability: Grafana, Prometheus.
Other: technical writing, mentoring, public speaking.
</document>

Assess the candidate against the posting below. A numbered requirement that
lists several items counts as one requirement, credited in proportion to how
many of those items the candidate shows. Report the mandatory match
percentage. If it lands between 78 and 84 percent, also report the combined
figure over all requirements and proceed only if that reaches 85 percent.

response.text:
# Candidate Assessment

## Mandatory Requirements (10)

| # | Requirement | Evidence in résumé | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Python | Languages: Python | 1.0 |
| 2 | SQL | Languages: SQL | 1.0 |
| 3 | Linux administration | Platform: Linux administration | 1.0 |
| 4 | Git | Platform: Git | 1.0 |
| 5 | REST API design | Services: REST API design | 1.0 |
| 6 | Unit testing | Services: unit testing | 1.0 |
| 7 | CI pipelines | Services: CI pipelines | 1.0 |
| 8 | Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Ansible, Helm | Has 4 of 5 (no Helm) | 0.8 |
| 9 | Kafka | Not listed | 0.0 |
| 10 | GraphQL | Not listed | 0.0 |

**Mandatory match: 7.8 / 10 = 78%**

## Combined Check

78% is in the 78–84% band, so the combined figure is required.

| # | Nice-to-have | Evidence | Credit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 11 | Grafana | Observability: Grafana | 1.0 |
| 12 | Prometheus | Observability: Prometheus | 1.0 |
| 13 | Technical writing | Other: technical writing | 1.0 |
| 14 | Mentoring | Other: mentoring | 1.0 |
| 15 | Public speaking | Other: public speaking | 1.0 |

**Combined match: (7.8 + 5) / 15 = 12.8 / 15 ≈ 85.3%**

## Result

**Proceed.** The combined figure of about 85.3% meets the 85% threshold.

## Caveats

- **Boundary case:** 78% is exactly the lower edge of the band. I read "between 78 and 84" as inclusive. If the band is exclusive, the combined check wouldn't apply, and the instructions don't say what to do at 78% outside the band. The rule should be clarified.
- **Narrow margin:** The candidate clears 85% by only about 0.3 points. Showing one fewer item in requirement 8 (3/5 instead of 4/5) would drop the mandatory score to 77%. That is below the band, and under a strict reading the candidate would not qualify.
- **Gaps to probe in interview:** Kafka, GraphQL, and Helm. These are the only mandatory items without evidence.
- **Limits of the evidence:** The résumé only lists skills. It gives no depth, years of experience, or project context, so all credit is based on self-reported keywords.
